spec_references: Module-level declarations: Class definition — Supports `object-field`, `method-defn` and `object-type-inclusion` members
Module-level declarations: Function definition — Supports `required-params`, `defaultable-params`, `included-record-param` and `rest-param` in the signature

reason: The case checks static rejection of missing or wrongly typed arguments and an incompatible future result type when starting function-valued object fields. Classes with function fields, anonymous functions, required/rest parameters, field invocations and start actions are supported, with no applicable invocation restriction excluding these positional calls. All asserted diagnostics concern supported argument and result typing.
test_design_notes: Negative compilation case: four @error annotations assert rejection; the zero-argument rest call is permitted and is not executed by this diagnostic test.
